revision.revision_reason: Polaroid verifies its changes with the shared procedure. The gate is what CI runs (make ci), one command at a time for per-command evidence.

#129 (ADR-0041): opt in to dev.change.verify v6's conditional artifact reference, so completing a verified change also builds a lightweight, local, gitignored Linux AMD64 verification artifact (scripts/build-artifact.sh, go.module.artifact) for independent review. Not a release: gate_commands, build_command and artifacts are unchanged from revision 1.
